notes: Covering task for C-38bb2e3e (recover deleted/embedded files and materialize byte-accurately into a clean directory). Hard: agent must parse a fully specified custom binary snapshot format (superblock, 128-byte inode slots, extent records), apply layered selection rules (deleted flag, CRC validation, size/extent consistency, highest-version-per-name among deleted candidates), and materialize exact bytes into /app/recovered with nothing extra, plus a quantified JSON report. The tool must generalize to hidden images with garbage slots, stale lower versions, higher versions with bad CRC, extent/size inconsistencies, live-file decoys, and an empty deleted file. Nonzero rubric for reasoning depth (binary format + selection rules), adversarial inputs and hidden-case generalization (>=2 hidden images with decoys), quantitative correctness (byte-exact files + sha256/size/version report), tool breadth (a reusable CLI subcommand), dependent stages (parse -> validate -> select -> materialize), and mild debugging ambiguity (decoy debugging).
